title: The Gone Telescope
scene: At 8:35 PM, the observatory telescope lens vanished. The dome was shut during clouds from 8:15 to 9:00.

suspects.name: Ravi Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the telescope at 8:35, waiting for the clouds.
suspects.contradiction: The dome was shut at 8:15, and lens caps were in Ravi's case.

suspects.name: Selma Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the control room at 8:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The control camera shows Selma at 8:33 and 8:41.

suspects.name: Theo Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the lobby at 8:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby camera shows Theo at 8:32.

suspects.name: Uma Reed
suspects.testimony: I was giving a tour in the hall at 8:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The tour log shows Uma's group at 8:34.
